items.title: Stop timeout during a profile switch only writes a log line
items.reason: waitForVpnStopped returns void after 5000 ms. At expiry its only evidence is one hilog.warn at Index.ets:1217. reloadTunnel calls it at Index.ets:1192 and then starts the new profile. disconnect calls it at Index.ets:1145 and then reports Idle. hld.md:106 expects a reported timeout and no new start. The timeout quality condition has no matching evidence.

items.title: Accessibility labels cover five controls only
items.reason: The product sets accessibilityText in five places only: Index.ets:1662, Index.ets:1733, Index.ets:2058, Index.ets:2248 and AppPicker.ets:375. The add menu Text('＋') at Index.ets:1746 has no label. The close Text('✕') controls at ProfileEdit.ets:572, UdpFallback.ets:120 and CustomRules.ets:484 have no label. A selected row shows a Text('✓') at Index.ets:2221 and exposes no accessibility state. The accessibility-label condition has partial evidence.

items.title: Failure text reaches the Chinese UI in English
items.reason: base and zh_CN string.json hold the same 302 keys and the same %s and %d counts. Some paths bypass these resources. The extension writes English reasons at lines 176, 298, 314, 350 and 374 of SsVpnExtensionAbility.ets. Index.ets:1292 passes them through failureText and the page shows the result. QrDialog.ets:68 and ProfileQr.ets:83 show the raw English encoder message. Diagnostics.ets:501 and Diagnostics.ets:534 supply English verdict text. lld.md:793 records the choice to keep extension reasons in English. The localized-string condition has partial evidence.

items.title: Native log lines reach hilog with no redaction
items.reason: flushCoreLogs copies every line from sslocal.recentLogs() to hilog at INFO level. It applies no filter and no redaction. The ArkTS layer obeys lld.md:5370 and logs no password. The allowed inputs give no evidence that the core's own records exclude credentials. The no-password-logging condition has no evidence for this path.

coverage.note: Six quality scenarios appear in architecture.md. All have a mechanism and five match the Expected column. The profile-switch failure path does not match. Permissions, secret handling, colour tokens, memory, battery and API level have a mechanism and evidence. Localization, accessibility and the forwarded native log path have partial evidence. The requirements file and QrDialog.ets changed during the review, so all anchors were re-checked at 2026-10-28 12:26 AEDT. R-UF-31 is android-only in the current requirements.md and the VPN self-grant is a recorded emulator workaround, so neither was scored as a HarmonyOS gap.
